name: Troy
description: The undisputed king of Toverland and the tallest, fastest and longest wooden roller coaster in the entire Benelux region. Troy stands 32 metres tall and reaches a terrifying top speed of 90 km/h through its twisting, banking wooden structure, inspired by the ancient story of the Trojan Horse. Great Coasters International built this masterpiece of wooden coaster engineering, and every element is designed to maximise airtime and lateral forces. The combination of steep drops, banked turns and relentless speed makes Troy one of the finest wooden coasters in Europe — an absolute must-ride.

name: Fenix
description: A spectacular B&M Wing Coaster soaring 40 metres above Toverland's Avalon themed area — the tallest and most impressive roller coaster at the park. On a Wing Coaster, riders sit in pairs extending beyond both sides of the track with nothing above or below their feet, creating the extraordinary sensation of true flight as the coaster banks, dives and loops through its layout. Themed to the mythical phoenix rising from the flames of King Arthur's realm, Fenix cost 17 million euros and opened in 2018 as the centrepiece of the Avalon expansion. Four inversions deliver moments of genuine weightlessness.

name: Booster Bike
description: The world's first motorbike roller coaster — a genuine piece of theme park history that launched Toverland onto the international stage when it opened in 2004. Built by Dutch manufacturer Vekoma and winner of the Best Idea Award at Euro Amusement Show Paris, Booster Bike seats riders on motorbike-styled seats leaning forward in a racing position, then catapults them from 0 to 75 km/h in just 3 seconds via hydraulic cable launch. The out-and-back layout tears through hills, a horseshoe and a horizontal loop in 55 exhilarating seconds. A prototype that inspired motorbike coasters worldwide.

name: Dwervelwind
description: A unique spinning family coaster set in the heart of the Wunderwald forest area, where individual cars rotate freely throughout the ride giving every journey a completely different experience. No two rides on Dwervelwind are ever the same as the spinning cars are influenced by the track layout, rider weight distribution and pure chance. Perfect for families with older children seeking genuine thrills without the intensity of Troy or Fenix.

name: Dragon's Fury
description: A fast-paced spinning coaster themed to dragons in Toverland's magical world, delivering exciting twists and unpredictable rotations as the car spins through the layout. Dragon's Fury combines genuine coaster thrills with the disorienting fun of free spinning, making it accessible to families while still providing real excitement. The dragon theming and dramatic colour scheme make this one of the most visually striking rides in the park.

name: Maximus Blitz Bahn
description: An electrifying electric bobkart track that winds both indoors and outdoors through the Ithaka themed area, offering fast-paced racing in individual kart-style vehicles through sweeping corners and descents. Maximus Blitz Bahn is one of Toverland's most beloved family attractions, combining the excitement of go-kart racing with the unpredictability of a roller coaster layout. Ride it while you can — the park confirmed in 2025 that a new attraction will eventually replace it at this location.

name: Scorpios
description: A spectacular giant swinging ship located in Toverland's Port Laguna harbour area, tilting to a terrifying 75 degrees as it swings higher and higher above the crowd below. Scorpios is one of the most intense non-coaster thrills in the park, with the front and back rows delivering powerful negative g-forces at the peak of each swing. The nautical theming and harbourside setting make it one of the most atmospheric rides in the entire park.

name: Pixarus
description: A thrilling tower ride in the Avalon area that launches riders upward and then free-falls them back down in a stomach-dropping plunge. Pixarus delivers intense vertical thrills in a compact footprint, with the Avalon castle backdrop creating a dramatic visual experience. The combination of the launch upward and freefall back down makes Pixarus one of the most intense single experiences in the park for those who want pure vertical thrills.

name: Merlin's Quest
description: A magical boat ride through the atmospheric valley of Avalon, gliding past enchanted forests, ancient ruins and mystical scenes from the legend of Merlin the Wizard and King Arthur's court. Merlin's Quest is Toverland's most beautifully themed dark ride — a gentle, immersive journey suitable for all ages that takes guests deep into the mythology of Avalon. The attention to detail in the scenery, lighting and soundtrack makes this one of the most memorable experiences in the park.

name: Toos-Express
description: A charming family roller coaster in the colourful Land van Toos children's world, providing a first coaster experience for young guests in a safe and perfectly themed environment. Toos-Express winds through the magical land of Toos at gentle speeds, giving children their first taste of coaster excitement while parents can ride alongside. One of the most important family attractions in the park for visits with very young children.

name: Land van Toos
description: Toverland's dedicated magical children's world — a richly themed area filled with gentle rides, interactive attractions, climbing structures and play areas all themed around the beloved Dutch mascot Toos and her friends. Land van Toos is the heart of Toverland's offering for the youngest guests and provides hours of entertainment for children under 8, with the entire family welcome to join in the magical adventures.

name: Avalon
description: Toverland's most breathtaking themed land — a fully realised medieval kingdom inspired by Arthurian legend, featuring Fenix, Merlin's Quest, Pixarus and Scorpios all within a spectacularly themed castle and harbour environment. The Avalon expansion opened in 2018 and transformed Toverland into one of Europe's most ambitiously themed parks. The immersive architecture, detailed scenery, atmospheric lighting and original soundtrack make Avalon a genuinely world-class themed environment.

name: Dragon Watch
description: An elevated observation gondola in the Avalon area offering stunning panoramic views across the entire Toverland park and the beautiful Limburg countryside beyond. Dragon Watch provides a magical bird's-eye perspective of the park's six themed worlds, the Avalon castle, and on clear days the rolling landscape of the Dutch-German border region. A perfect attraction for families wanting to get their bearings and plan the rest of their day.

name: Port Laguna
description: A spectacular water attraction in the Port Laguna harbour area — a thrilling log flume or river rapids ride that delivers dramatic splashes and genuine soakings in a beautifully themed nautical setting. Port Laguna is one of Toverland's essential summer attractions, perfect for cooling down on hot days while still delivering genuine excitement through its drops and rapids.
